final_visual_plan.visual: Cozy home evening, low table or sofa edge. Aachu holds her phone close to the viewer with a large harmless app verification timer reading 30 seconds. Zuv sits beside her with his own phone showing a tiny OTP message. Both realize the countdown has turned a normal task into a mission.
Zuv reads the OTP from his phone too calmly while Aachu types into her phone too fast. Both phones are visible, with the countdown still implied on her screen.
The digit confusion lands physically. Zuv's finger partly covers one digit on his OTP phone. Aachu's thumb freezes mid-type over her phone. Both eye-lines snap to the screens at the same time.
Aachu's phone shows one large simple expired state. Both stare at the screen in silence like the timer personally betrayed them.

They physically reset. Aachu and Zuv move closer side by side, both phones angled toward each other on the table, hands nearly overlapping as they prepare the resend. The retry looks like a tiny mission-control operation.
The app screen shows a simple submitted checkmark. Both release the tension at once with a tiny celebration: eye contact, shared exhale, small relieved smile, shoulders dropping.

Both phones are face-down after the crisis. Aachu and Zuv lean back together laughing softly, like they survived something far bigger than a normal OTP. The cozy home scene feels complete and ordinary again.
